profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pearson
profile.summary: I am a software developer with 6 years of experience with both front-end and back-end development experience. I work with JavaScript, React, Vue, Go, and PostgreSQL, as well as have experience with Python, Ansible, Docker, and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Working with Pearson Education
- Engineered framework-agnostic Vue 3.5 custom web components using Typescript, leveraging ShadowDOM encapsulation for seamless external application integration.
- Built an extensible configuration system, enabling dynamic component control through callback mechanisms and event-driven communication for bidirectional data flow with host applications.
-Architected a flexible, reusable component library using Vue 3.5 and SCSS to ensure consistent UI and behavior across the application and overcoming ShadowDOM encapsulation constraints. 
-Collaborated with team to solve complex, cross-boundary communication challenges through event-driven architecture and prop-based configuration, enabling seamless integration of web components.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · TypeScript · Scss · Front-End Development

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded front-end development to upgrade React from v15.4 to 18.2, Material-UI from v0 to v5.15, and Webpack from 4.46 to 5.88, as well as resolved over 40 NPM security vulnerabilities to significantly improve functionality and security of the application.
- Identified and implemented changes to improve the stability and connectivity of the application.
- Consulted with design team to elicit user feedback and applied recommendations to improve UX/UI and increase number of users.
- Collaborated with users to obtain feedback regarding errors or issues they encountered in the environment, resolving the issues and ensuring the application is able to function in a variety of environments.
- Quickly and efficiently resolved over 50 bugs that were identified.
- Leveraged Webpack plugins to expose application as a micro front-end to improve functionality across use within other applications and eliminate style conflicts.
- Developed knowledge and experience using Golang and PostgreSQL.
- Participated in re-designing the architecture of several database tables to more effectively track data and allow for future changes.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Go (Programming Language) · SQL · Redux · Webpack

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an API to manage user identities and permissions in multiple environments to nearly eliminate reliance on manual initial user creation and management, speeding up customer access by 2 weeks.
- Efficiently utilized prior knowledge to join team with focus on database development and automation  projects. 
- Rapidly gained insight and understanding of a larger and more complex build environment.
- Investigated and resolved any barriers to API deployment or information processing.
- Participated in design and implementation discussions to identify challenges and ways to overcome them.

positions.title: Technical Intern with the Cloud Native Engineering team
positions.description:
- Quickly learned proprietary systems and environments quickly for development and testing.
- Utilized Gitlab pipelines and Ansible to automate the process of developing and configuring Windows virtual machines.
- Expanded knowledge and use of technologies such as Ansible, Docker and Terraform in order to become a productive member of a new team.
- Coordinated with a global team to facilitate the completion of a multi-team project in a timely manner.

positions.title: Front-End Development Student
positions.description:
• Dedicated 12 weeks specializing in a highly focused, immersive training program centered on language fluency, object-oriented programming, and project-based learning.
• Traction: Worked with a team of front-end and back-end students to use React in Ruby on Rails to create an application that tracks the distribution of Naloxone Kits and the use of kits in overdose reversals. Traction allows volunteers to use a QR code scanner to track distribution, vastly improving efficiency and security in the data collection process.
• Worked as a sole front-end developer with a team of back-end developers to create a quiz-taking application allowing administrators to sign on to view and create published and unpublished quizzes, and users to take published quizzes.
• Created an application to search and play songs using Ajax to make HTTP requests to the iTunes API.
• Used JSON Server to create APIs for use in development.
• Created a canvas-based game in JavaScript using object-oriented programming.
• Wrote JavaScript function to validate multiple types of form fields.
• Developed a note-taking application in JavaScript using Ajax to make HTTP requests to an API to store and edit notes.

positions.title: EAP Counselor
positions.description:
• Provided telephonic emotional support and resources to global employees at a variety of companies.
• Effectively managed and de-escalated crises and provided appropriate interventions as needed.

positions.title: Carolina Outreach
positions.description:
• Trained and supervised team members, trained new hires, and reviewed and monitored proper documentation for all clients served by the team.
• Conducted biopsychosocial assessments to identify diagnosis and create treatment plans for clients.
• Provided individual psychotherapy to clients using a variety of evidence-based practices.

positions.title: Direct Support Professional
positions.description: • Provided necessary support and information to enhance the ability of residents with Intellectual and/or Developmental Disability diagnoses to lead self-determining lives.

certifications.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations 2020 Certified Associate
